Source: STDI-0002-2 v2021.1, Appendix D: CSSHPA and CSSHPB DES
Name: Shapefile DES Version B
Description: The Shapefile DES Version B (CSSHPB) extends the Shapefile DES Version A (CSSHPA) to allow for significantly larger shapefiles and additional metadata and information beyond what is defined in Version A.

SHAPEFILE_ID.Name: Shapefile Identifier
SHAPEFILE_ID.Description: This field contains the ID of the shapefile contained (or partially contained) in this DES. The value of this field shall be a UUID in canonical form.

SHAPES_ID.Name: Shape Identifiers
SHAPES_ID.Description: This field contains the ID of the complete set of shapes contained across all shapefiles where the complete set of shapes was split into multiple independent shapefiles. The value of this field shall be a UUID in canonical form.

NUMAIS.Name: Number of Associated Image Segments
NUMAIS.Description: This field contains the number of associated image segments. The value of this field can be the range of whole numbers 000-998 or "ALL".

AISDLVL<NUMAIS>.Name: Associated Image Segment Display Level
AISDLVL<NUMAIS>.Description: This field contains the associated image segment's display level.

TIMESTAMP.Name: UTC Timestamp
TIMESTAMP.Description: This field contains the UTC Time at which this shapefile is associated. The format of the value range is: CCYYMMDDhhmmss.sssssssss. Trailing digits are set to hyphens ("-") if unknown.

NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Name: Number of Elements
NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Description: This field contains the number of elements associated with this shapefile.

ASSOC_ELEM_ID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Name: Associated Element UUID
ASSOC_ELEM_ID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Description: This field contains the UUID of the ith element associated with this shapefile. The value of this field shall be a UUID in canonical form.

SHAPE_USE.Name: Shapefile Use
SHAPE_USE.Description: This field describes the use of the shapefile. The values of this field are defined in Table D.5-2. Other values can be registered with the GWG NTB.

NUM_SHAPE_USE_ATTR.Name: Number of Shapefile Use Attributes
NUM_SHAPE_USE_ATTR.Description: This field contains the number of attributes specified to differentiate multiple instances of the CSSHPB DES with the same value of the SHAPE_USE field.

SHAPE_USE_ATTR_NAME<NUM_SHAPE_USE_ATTR>.Name: Shapefile Use Attribute Name
SHAPE_USE_ATTR_NAME<NUM_SHAPE_USE_ATTR>.Description: This field names the ith SHAPE_USE attribute. The values of this field, defined in Table D.5-3, are case-insensitive. Other values and corresponding value ranges can be regustered with the GWG NTB.

SHAPE_USE_ATTR_VALUE<NUM_SHAPE_USE_ATTR>.Name: Shapefile Use Attribute Value
SHAPE_USE_ATTR_VALUE<NUM_SHAPE_USE_ATTR>.Description: This field provides the value of the ith SHAPE_USE attribute for this instance of the CSSHPB DES. The values of this field, defined in Table D.5-3, should correspond to SHAPE_USE_ATTR_NAMEi.

SHAPE_CLASS.Name: Type of Shapes
SHAPE_CLASS.Description: This field describes the type of shapes contained within this shapefile. The values of this field are defined in Table D.5-4.

SHAPE_COORD.Name: Shape Coordinate System
SHAPE_COORD.Description: This field contains the coordinate system in which the actual shapes are specified. The values of this field are defined in Table D.5-5. Other values can be registered with the GWG NTB.

SHAPE_VERSION.Name: Shape Version
SHAPE_VERSION.Description: This field contains the version number of the ESRI Shapefile Technical Description to which the shapefile in this DES conforms.

SHAPE_PART.Name: Shapefile Sequence Number
SHAPE_PART.Description: This field contains the sequence number of the shapefile contained or partially contained in this DES.

SHAPE_NUM_PARTS.Name: Number of Complete Shapefiles
SHAPE_NUM_PARTS.Description: This field contains the number of complete shapefiles in this NITF file necessary to store all of the shape data for a single SHAPE_USE and a single set of attributes and attribute values.

SOURCE.Name: Source Sensor
SOURCE.Description: This field contains the source sensor(s) from which the shape data was determined or generated; the source sensors are provided for all types of shapes, not just for cloud shapes. Legal values for this field are the same as those defined for CC_SOURCE in CSSHPA, as seen in table D.4-3. If more than one value applies for this field, separate multiple field values with commas. Other values for this field can be registered with the GWG NTB.

SHAPE1_NAME.Name: Name of First Component
SHAPE1_NAME.Description: This field contains the name of the first component file in the shapefile stored in this instance of the CSSHPB DES. The values of this field are defined in Table D.5-6, and for version 1 only, this field can also be populated with the values in Table D.5-7. For version 1, other values can be registered with the GWG NTB.

SHAPE1_START.Name: Start Location of First Component
SHAPE1_START.Description: This field contains the start location of the first component stored in this instance of the CSSHPB DES.

SHAPE2_NAME.Name: Name of Second Component
SHAPE2_NAME.Description: This field contains the name of the second component file in the shapefile stored in this instance of the CSSHPB DES. The values of this field are defined in Table D.5-6, and for version 1 only, this field can also be populated with the values in Table D.5-7. For version 1, other values can be registered with the GWG NTB.

SHAPE2_START.Name: Start Location of Second Component
SHAPE2_START.Description: This field contains the start location of the second component stored in this instance of the CSSHPB DES.

SHAPE3_NAME.Name: Name of Third Component
SHAPE3_NAME.Description: This field contains the name of the third component file in the shapefile stored in this instance of the CSSHPB DES. The values of this field are defined in Table D.5-6, and for version 1 only, this field can also be populated with the values in Table D.5-7. For version 1, other values can be registered with the GWG NTB.

SHAPE3_START.Name: Start Location of Third Component
SHAPE3_START.Description: This field contains the start location of the third component stored in this instance of the CSSHPB DES.

NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES.Name: Number of Supporting Files
NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES.Description: This field contains the number of supporting files.

SUPPORTING_NAME_LEN<NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES.Name: nth Supporting File Name Length
SUPPORTING_NAME_LEN<NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES.Description: This field contains the length in bytes of the nth supporting file.

SUPPORTING_NAME<NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES>.Name: nth Supporting File Name
SUPPORTING_NAME<NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES>.Description: This field contains the name of the nth supporting file. The value of this field is specified in Table D.5-7. Other values can be registered with the GWG NTB.

SUPPORTING_START<NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES>.Name: nth Supporting File Start Location
SUPPORTING_START<NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES>.Description: This field contains the start location in bytes of the nth supporting file stored in this instance of the CSSHPB DES.

SUPPORTING_SIZE<NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES>.Name: nth Supporting File Size
SUPPORTING_SIZE<NUM_SUPPORTING_FILES>.Description: This field contains the size in bytes of the nth supporting file stored in this instance of the CSSHPB DES.
